title: Add RecipesFolderStore
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipesFolderStore.swift as an @Observable class (or ObservableObject if @Observable causes issues on iOS 17). On init, reads bookmark Data from UserDefaults key 'recipesFolderBookmark', resolves it with withSecurityScope, and sets folderURL: URL?. If isStale is true after resolution, clears both UserDefaults keys and sets folderURL to nil. Exposes folderName: String? from UserDefaults key 'recipesFolderName'. Provides saveBookmark(for url: URL) to write bookmark Data and display name on successful picker selection.
acceptance_criteria: Reads and resolves bookmark from UserDefaults 'recipesFolderBookmark' on init
Exposes folderURL: URL? (nil when no bookmark or stale)
Stale bookmark is detected, both UserDefaults keys cleared, folderURL set to nil
saveBookmark(for:) creates security-scoped bookmark and persists Data + display name
No database or custom storage layer — UserDefaults.standard only

handoff_summary.completed: CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipesFolderStore.swift created with all required behaviour: bookmark resolution on init, stale-bookmark clearing, folderURL/folderName exposure, saveBookmark(for:) implementation, UserDefaults.standard only.
handoff_summary.remaining: No remaining work in this bead. Downstream beads should inject or share RecipesFolderStore via the environment (e.g. @Environment or passed through AppRoot) so FolderSetupView and SettingsView can call saveBookmark(for:) and AppRoot can observe folderURL for gating.
handoff_summary.risks: folderName is a computed property that reads UserDefaults on every access — not @Observable-tracked. If views need to react to folderName changes they should observe folderURL (which is tracked) as a proxy, since both are written together in saveBookmark and clearBookmark. This is a known design trade-off; a stored property alternative would require manually syncing with UserDefaults.
handoff_summary.next_action: Pass to tester agent for RecipesFolderStore round-trip and stale-bookmark unit tests as specified in spec 0003.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. This is a new file with no overlap with existing sources. Downstream beads that create AppRoot gating or SettingsView wiring will need to instantiate and inject this store.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used @Observable over ObservableObject — iOS 17.0 deployment target confirmed in project.yml, so Observation framework is available. folderName is computed from UserDefaults rather than stored as @Observable state because it is always written atomically alongside the bookmark; observing folderURL is sufficient for views to re-render.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Unit tests for RecipesFolderStore (round-trip bookmark, stale detection) are out of scope for the developer agent and should be implemented by the tester agent per spec 0003 test requirements.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: folderName changes are not directly observable via @Observable machinery since it reads UserDefaults lazily. Views must treat a folderURL change as the signal to re-read folderName.

conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. This is a new file with no overlap with existing sources. Downstream beads that create AppRoot gating or SettingsView wiring will need to instantiate and inject this store.

execution_history.summary: Created RecipesFolderStore.swift as an @Observable class using the Observation framework (iOS 17+). On init it resolves any persisted security-scoped bookmark from UserDefaults; stale bookmarks are detected and both UserDefaults keys are cleared. folderName is a computed property reading directly from UserDefaults. saveBookmark(for:) creates a security-scoped bookmark and persists both the bookmark Data and the folder's lastPathComponent as display name.
